scored_features.gate_reasoning: G1: Baseline systolic blood pressure (sbp) is listed in the trial_measured_features, so the feature is observed in the dataset (G1 TRUE). G2: All provided mechanism variants describe higher or lower baseline cardiovascular risk, event trajectories, or competing-risk profiles without naming receptors, enzymes, PK/PD changes, or a concrete biological pathway linking SBP to differential drug action, so the mechanism is a statistical/epidemiologic claim rather than a biological one (G2 FALSE — cascade: G3..G5 also FALSE). G3: Because G2 failed, the hypothesis does not claim a genuine PD/PK or pathophysiologic difference in how intensive BP lowering acts across SBP strata (G3 FALSE). G4: As G2/G3 are false here, there is no specific biologically coherent SBP×treatment interaction to check against literature in this submission (G4 FALSE). G5: Without a biologically coherent, literature-backed interaction, the proposal does not define clear operational subgroups with distinct treatment recommendations (G5 FALSE).
scored_features.justification: Decisive gate: G2 failed because the hypotheses only posit baseline-risk/absolute-benefit relationships without naming any concrete biological mechanism (receptor, enzyme, PK/PD pathway), so downstream gates cannot be satisfied.
